# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label:  setup

cran <- c("parallel", "sommer")
git <- c("hemstrow/snpR") # https://github.com/hemstrow/snpR

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  for (pkg in cran) { 
    if( !require(pkg, character.only = TRUE) ) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } 
  }
  
  for (pkg in git) {
    if( !require(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE) ) {
      devtools::install_github(pkg, upgrade = TRUE)
      library(sub(".*/", "", pkg), character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}); remove(cran, git, pkg)

# remotes::install_github("hemstrow/snpR")

ncores <- floor(parallel::detectCores()*0.8)
set.seed(2025)

library(rrBLUP)
library(vcfR)
library(data.table)
library(rsample)
library(gtsummary)

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

For the large files was created a `xclude` folder and add the name to the `.gitignore` to avoid upload files saved in this folder to the server

# Phenotypic data

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WQKAOnxO9on7YoF9yC2WV7eHcChZJ5FR6DVyg0tJK1o/edit#gid=0"
gs <- url %>% as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>%
  range_read("STable2") %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(trial, pop, num, type)) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(line
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("cross", "nline")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       , too_few = "align_start"
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "SALx", ) ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "xKAN", ) ~ "KAN"
    , .default = cross
  ), .before = "cross")
  

fb %>% web_table(caption = "Phenotypic data")

traits <- gs %>%
  range_read("STable1") %>% 
  mutate(trait = paste0(traits, " ", "(", units, ")", "\nstage: ", phenology))

traitnames <- traits %>% dplyr::select(abbreviations, trait) %>% deframe()
```

```{r}
fbdist <- fb %>% 
  drop_na(nline) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(pop:line), names_to = "trait") %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(trait
                       , delim = "_"
                       , names = c("variable", "phenology")
                       , cols_remove = FALSE
                       ) %>% 
  mutate(label = dplyr::recode(trait, !!!traitnames))

fbdist$trait %>% unique() %>% dput()

order <- c("ndflw_flw"
           , "plth_flw"
           , "pnlg_flw", "pnwd_flw"
           , "ndpm_mtr"
           , "plth_mtr"
           , "pnlg_mtr", "pnwd_mtr"
           , "mstd_mtr"
           , "sdyp_hrv", "yplt_hrv", "wl_mtr")

lb <- fbdist %>% 
  dplyr::select(trait, label) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  deframe()

dist <- fbdist %>% 
  mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = order)) %>% 
  arrange(trait) %>% 
  plot_raw(type = "box"
         , x = "pop"
         , y = "value"
         , legend = "none"
         , xlab = "Population"
         , ylab = ""
           ) +
  facet_wrap(~ trait, scales = "free_y"
             , labeller = as_labeller(lb)
             , nrow = 3
             ) + 
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1)

dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL
dist$layers[[1]] <- NULL

fig <- dist %>% 
  ggsave2(filename = "manuscript/SFigure-02.jpg"
          , units = "cm", width = 30, height = 15)

fig %>% include_graphics()
```

# Genotypic data

Genotypic data is in a BCF file which has more than 2 Gb large and harbors >900.000 SNPs. In order to keep the running times manageable, the number of SNPs has to be reduce.

The snp pruning were performed in the server of the Crop Biodiversity and Breeding Informatics groups at University of Hohenheim.

```{bash}
#| eval: false

ssh flaaw57@server231.ipsp.uni-hohenheim.de
cd /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/
cd /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/

# -e stands for "exclude." It removes variants that meet the specified condition.
# F_MISSING refers to the fraction of missing data at a variant site.
# > 0.5 means any variants where more than 50% of the data are missing will be excluded (filtered out).

bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.5' -O z /work/workspaces/novogene-sequencing-job-2021/vcfs/quinoa_run1_all.bcf > /work/workspaces/flavio/quinoagenetics/quinoa.vcf.gz

# export names to rename
bcftools query -l quinoa.vcf.gz > genotype_names.txt
```

## Genotypes names to rename vcf file

```{r}
#| eval: false

vcf.names <- "genetics/genotype_names.txt" %>% 
  read.csv(header = F, col.names = "name_old") %>% 
  mutate(pmatch = toupper(name_old)) %>% 
  mutate(match = gsub(".*A(.+)_F.*", "\\1", pmatch)) %>% 
  select(!pmatch)

parents <- c("blanca de juli" = "BDJ"
             , "chulpi" = "CHU"
             , "ayrampo" = "AYR"
             , "choclito" = "CHO")

geno.names <- "genetics/camacani_plots_cs-genotyping.xlsx" %>% 
  readxl::read_xlsx() %>% 
  mutate(cross = recode(cross, !!!parents)) %>% 
  unite(match, c(plots, crossn, line), remove = F, sep = "_") %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    cross %in% c("SAL", "PAN", "HUA", "KCA", "COL", "BDJ", "CHU", "AYR", "CHO", "PAS") ~  as.character(paste(cross, line, crossn, sep = "_"))
    , TRUE ~ as.character(paste(cross, line, sep = "_"))
  )) %>% 
  select(match, name_new) 

vcf.rename <- merge(vcf.names, geno.names, by = "match", all.x = T) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = case_when(
    is.na(name_new) ~ name_old
    , TRUE ~ name_new
  )) %>% 
  select(!match) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("KCA", "KAN", name_new)) %>% 
  mutate(name_new = gsub("COL", "NCO", name_new))

tab <- vcf.rename %>% 
  distinct(name_new) 

vcf.rename %>% write_tsv("genetics/vcf.rename.txt")
```


# Objectives

## (i) Assess the inter and intra-population genetic differentiation of the NAM populations

- Fig 1: (a) PCA, (b) POPstructure, (c) FST,  and (d) LD by NAM pop
- Table with diversity value for NAM pop

### PCA

```{r}
pca <- plot_clusters(snpdt_filt, facets = c("pop.cross")
                     , check_duplicates = TRUE
                     , plot_type = "pca"
                     , shape_has_more_levels = FALSE 
                     )

paleta <- c("#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02")

p1a <- pca$plots$pca +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pop, color = cross), size = 1.7) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("KAN" = 16, "SAL" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = paleta) +
  labs(
    color = "Cross",
    shape = "Population"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1a
```

### Population structure

```{r}
#| cache: true

popstr_k <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 2:10
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , reps = 20
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , clumpp_path = "C:/CLUMPP/CLUMPP.exe"
                               )

plot_sfa <- popstr_k$plot

# Calcular la entropía cruzada promedio y desviación estándar por cada K
k_summary <- popstr_k$K_plot %>%
  group_by(k) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_entropy = mean(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_entropy = sd(Cross.Entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Visualizar la curva de entropía cruzada
plot_sfb <- ggplot(k_summary, aes(x = k, y = mean_entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Optimal K value selection with sNMF",
    x = "Number of clusters (K)",
    y = "Mean cross-entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_summary$k) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

list(plot_sfa + 
       scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Paired") + 
       theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
      )
     , plot_sfb 
     ) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.3)) %>% 
  ggsave2(plot = ., "manuscript/SFigure-01.jpg"
                 , width = 35, height = 30, units = "cm")

popstr <- snpR::plot_structure(x = snpdt_filt
                               , facet = "cross"
                               , k = 3
                               , method = "snmf"
                               , clumpp = FALSE
                               , reps = 1
                               )

p1b <- popstr$plot +
  scale_fill_brewer(type = "qua", palette = "Accent")

p1b
```

### SOMMER: LD decay

```{r}
#| eval: false

library(sommer)
library(vcfR)
library(tidyverse)
library(snpR)

vcfdt <- read.vcfR("genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf") %>% 
  vcfR::vcfR2tidy()

mrk <- vcfdt$gt %>%
  mutate(gt_num = case_when(
    gt_GT == "0/0" ~ -1,
    gt_GT %in% c("0/1", "1/0") ~ 0,
    gt_GT == "1/1" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>%
  unite(Locus, c("ChromKey", "POS")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Indiv, Locus, gt_num) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Locus, values_from = gt_num
              , values_fn = list
              ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Indiv") 

str(mrk)

map <- vcfdt$fix %>% 
  unite("Locus", c("ChromKey", "POS"), remove = F) %>%
  dplyr::select(Locus, Position = POS, LG = CHROM) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(map)

ld_decay <- enhancer::LD.decay(mrk, map)


ld_decay$all.LG <- ld_decay$all.LG[which(ld_decay$all.LG$p < .001),]

#### plot the LD decay
with(res$all.LG, plot(r2~d,col=transp("cadetblue"),
                    xlim=c(0,55), ylim=c(0,1),
                    pch=20,cex=0.5,yaxt="n",
                    xaxt="n",ylab=expression(r^2),
                    xlab="Distance in cM")
                    )
axis(1, at=seq(0,55,5), labels=seq(0,55,5))
axis(2,at=seq(0,1,.1), labels=seq(0,1,.1), las=1)

#### if you want to add the loess regression lines
#### this could take a long time!!!
mod <- loess(r2 ~ d, data=res$all.LG)
par(new=T)
lilo <- predict(mod,data.frame(d=1:55))
plot(lilo, bty="n", xaxt="n", yaxt="n", col="green",
     type="l", ylim=c(0,1),ylab="",xlab="",lwd=2)
res3 <- LD.decay(markers=CPgeno, map=mapCP,
                unlinked = TRUE,gamma = .95)
abline(h=res3$all.LG, col="red")
```

## (ii) QTL mapping

```{r}
library(snpR)
library(tidyverse)
library(qtl2)

vcfile <- "G:/Mi unidad/coding/quinoa4gwas/quinoa_pops.vcf.gz"

snpdt <- snpR::read_vcf(file = vcfile)
snpdt

sample_meta <- snpdt %>% 
  names() %>% 
  gsub("_.*", "", .) %>% 
  enframe(value = "cross") %>% 
  mutate(pop = case_when(
    str_detect(cross, "xKAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "KAN") ~ "KAN"
    , str_detect(cross, "SALx") ~ "SAL"
    , str_detect(cross, "SAL") ~ "SAL"
  ))
  
sample.meta(snpdt)$cross <- factor(sample_meta$cross
                                   , levels = c("HUAxKAN", "NCOxKAN", "PASxKAN"
                                                , "SALxHUA", "SALxNCO", "SALxPAN"))
sample.meta(snpdt)$pop <- sample_meta$pop

sample.meta(snpdt)
snp.meta(snpdt)

snpdt_filt <- snpR::filter_snps(x = snpdt
                              , maf = 0.05
                              , min_ind = 0.5
                              , min_loci = 0.3
                              , maf_facets = "cross"
                              )

vcfdt <- format_snps(x = snpdt_filt
                     , output = "sn"
                     , interpolate = ""
                     , chr = "CHROM"
                     , position = "position"
                     , facets = "pop"
                     , verbose = TRUE
                     # , outfile = "genetics/pops/nam"
                     ) %>% 
  mutate(ID = paste0("marker", "_", row.names(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(1:FILTER)
               , names_to = "cross"
               , values_to = "gt"
               ) 

nam_pop <- vcfdt %>% 
  filter(str_detect(cross, "SALx")) 

gmap <- nam_pop %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cross, values_from = gt) %>% 
  dplyr::select(marker = ID, chr = CHROM, pos = position) %>% 
  mutate(across(pos, ~ as.numeric(.))) %>% 
  arrange(chr, pos) %>% 
  # mutate(chr = as.integer(as.factor(chr))) %>% 
  # mutate(pos = pos/1e6) %>% # bp -> Mbp
  distinct(chr, pos, .keep_all = TRUE)

gmap %>% write_csv("genetics/rqtl2/SAL_gmap.csv")

geno <- nam_pop %>%
  dplyr::select(id = cross, marker = ID, alleles = gt) %>% 
  mutate(alleles = case_when(
    alleles %in% 0 ~ "AA"
    , alleles %in% 1 ~ "AB"
    , alleles %in% 2 ~ "BB"
  )) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = marker
              , values_from = alleles) 

geno %>% write_csv("genetics/rqtl2/SAL_geno.csv")

pheno <- read_csv("genetics/mlt-sal.csv") %>% 
  rename(id = line)

pheno %>% write_csv("genetics/rqtl2/SAL_pheno.csv")

crossinfo <- pheno %>% 
  dplyr::select(id) %>% 
  mutate(cross = gsub("_[0-9]+$", "", id)) %>% 
  mutate(cross = as.integer(as.factor(cross)))

crossinfo$cross %>% unique()

crossinfo %>% write_csv("genetics/rqtl2/SAL_crossinfo.csv")
```

```{r}
ncores <- floor(parallel::detectCores()*0.8)

namqtl <- read_cross2("genetics/rqtl2/SAL.yaml")

map <- insert_pseudomarkers(namqtl$gmap, step = 0, cores = ncores)

pr <- calc_genoprob(cross = namqtl, map = map, cores = ncores
                    , quiet = F)

apr <- genoprob_to_alleleprob(pr, cores = ncores)

kinship <- calc_kinship(apr, "loco", cores = ncores)

out <- scan1(apr, namqtl$pheno, kinship, cores = ncores)

par(mar=c(5.1, 4.1, 1.1, 1.1))
ymx <- maxlod(out) # overall maximum LOD score
plot(out, map, lodcolumn=5, col="slateblue", ylim=c(0, ymx*1.5))


```


```{r}
knit_exit()
```



## (ii) Map and characterize QTL to elucidate their roles in yield architecture and cross-reference them with prior genomic findings in quinoa

```{bash}
VCF=genetics/pops/nam_KAN.vcf
RSL=genetics/pops/nam_KAN_qtl

plink2 \
  --vcf $VCF \
  --recode A \
  --out $RSL
```

```{r}

  pivot_longer(!c(1:POS), values_to = "p-value") %>% 
  separate(name, c("Trait", "Population"), sep = "-") %>%

  drop_na(alpha) %>% 
  mutate(Trait = dplyr::recode(Trait, !!!traitnames))
```

# NAM: Nested Association Mapping

- https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/NAM/index.html

## SALCEDO NAM

```{r}
pheno <- fb %>% 
  filter(grepl("SALx", line))

vcfdt  <- "genetics/pops/nam_SAL.vcf" %>% 
  vcfR::read.vcfR()

info <- vcfdt %>% 
  vcfR::getFIX() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(ID, ~ gsub("_", "",. ))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column()

chr <- info %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(chrome = gsub(".*([0-9]+[A-Z]+).*", "\\1", CHROM)) %>% 
  group_by(chrome) %>% 
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  deframe()
  
gwsdt <- vcfdt %>% 
  extract.gt() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(.), ~ case_when(
    . %in% "1/1" ~ 2
    , . %in% "0/1" ~ 1
    , . %in% "1/0" ~ 1
    , . %in% "0/0" ~ 0
  ))) %>% 
  rownames_to_column() %>% 
  arrange(rowname) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowname, names_to = "geno", values_to = "col") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "rowname", values_from = "col") %>% 
  separate(geno, c("family", "line"), remove = F) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!line) %>% 
  mutate(fam = case_when(
    family %in% "SALxPAN" ~ 1
    , family %in% "SALxNCO" ~ 2
    , family %in% "SALxHUA" ~ 3
  ), .after = family) %>% 
  merge(., pheno, by.x = "geno", by.y = "line")

rsl <- (length(gwsdt) - 11):length(gwsdt) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- gwsdt[x]
  
  nam_gwas = gwas(y = trait
                , gen = gwsdt %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("SNP_"))
                , fam = gwsdt$fam
                , chr = chr
                )
  
  plot(nam_gwas, alpha = alpha_sug
         , main = names(trait)
         ) %>% print
  
  nam_gwas$PolyTest %>% mutate(trait = names(trait)) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("ID")
  
}) 

gwas_sal_nam <- rsl %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, pval, trait) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = pval) %>% 
  base::merge(info, ., by = "ID") %>% 
  arrange(rowid) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid, REF:FILTER))
```

## (iii) Use genomic prediction in the NAM population to enhance breeding efficiency and accelerate genetic gain.

> Reference

https://pbgworks.org/sites/pbgworks.org/files/Introduction%20to%20Genomic%20Selection%20in%20R.pdf

```{r}
set.seed(as.numeric(1989-19-08))
```

# KAN Genomic Prediction

## Import data

```{r}
genotyping <- "genetics/pops/nam_KAN.vcf"  %>% 
  read.vcfR(., verbose = FALSE)

phenotyping <- "genetics/mlt-kan.csv" %>% 
  read.csv(.) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(genotypes = line)
```

## Transfor genotype data

```{r}
gt_matrix <- genotyping %>% 
  extract.gt(., element = "GT", as.numeric = TRUE, convertNA = TRUE)

# Transpose the matrix to have individuals as rows and markers as columns
gt_matrix <- t(gt_matrix)

# Replace numeric genotype codes (0, 1, 2) with rrBLUP's required codes (-1, 0, 1)
gt_matrix[gt_matrix == 0] <- -1  # Homozygous for parent 1
gt_matrix[gt_matrix == 1] <- 0   # Heterozygous
gt_matrix[gt_matrix == 2] <- 1   # Homozygous for parent 2
```

## Impute missing values

```{r}
# A.mat() can perform imputation as part of its relationship matrix calculation.
# However, for direct marker-based prediction (RR-BLUP), pre-imputation is
# often done. We can use the 'mean' method for a simple imputation strategy.
imputed_markers <- A.mat(gt_matrix
                         , max.missing = 0.5
                         , impute.method = "mean"
                         , return.imputed = T) %>% 
  pluck("imputed")
```

## Check data

```{r}
# Ensure sample IDs match in both genotype and phenotype data
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(imputed_markers), phenotyping$genotypes)
imputed_markers <- imputed_markers[common_samples, ]

phenotyping4gp <- phenotyping[phenotyping$genotypes %in% common_samples, ] %>% 
  tibble(.) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("genotypes")
```

## Itinerations

```{r}
traits <- colnames(phenotyping4gp)[1:length(phenotyping4gp)]

run_iteration <- function(trait, rep) {
  # Split 60/40
  split_data <- initial_split(phenotyping4gp, prop = 0.6)

  pheno_train <- training(split_data) %>% as.matrix()
  pheno_valid <- testing(split_data)  %>% as.matrix()

  geno_train <- imputed_markers[row.names(pheno_train), ]
  geno_valid <- imputed_markers[row.names(pheno_valid), ]

  # Modelo GBLUP con rrBLUP
  response <- mixed.solve(
    y = pheno_train[, trait],
    Z = geno_train,
    K = NULL,
    SE = FALSE,
    return.Hinv = FALSE
  )
  
  e <- as.matrix(response$u)
  response_predic <- as.vector((geno_valid %*% e)[, 1]) + as.numeric(response$beta)

  # Accuracy
  acc <- cor(response_predic, pheno_valid[, trait], use = "complete")
  
  # Normalized Root Mean Square Error (NRMSE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pheno_valid[, trait] - response_predic)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  nrmse <- rmse / sd(pheno_valid[, trait], na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    trait = trait,
    replication = rep,
    ntrain = nrow(pheno_train),
    nvalid = nrow(pheno_valid),
    accuracy = acc, # range: [-1 to +1]
    nrmse = nrmse # range: [0, >1] where: 0 high precision accuracy
  )
}
```

```{r}
GS_KAN <- traits %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(\(trait) {
    map_dfr(1:300, \(rep) run_iteration(trait, rep))
  }) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(pop = "KAN", .before = "trait")
```
